content.text: I want to make sure I answer for the right kid — is this about Ash's sleep, Bo's, or both? Also, what are you seeing (how many hours, how many wake-ups, at what times)? Sleep norms are pretty different at 3 months vs 7 years, so once I know which child and roughly what the pattern looks like, I can tell you if it lines up with what's typical for their age.
